reuse.why: getScheduledAmount and every server site now call the new getRangedAmount, though sites keep their own missing/number dispatch instead of reusing getScheduledAmount, which already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: The range rule is defined once, but the pre-existing null/number/range dispatch stays copied at four sites (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview, forecast) plus the op check in schedule-template.

placement.why: getRangedAmount sits in shared/schedules next to getScheduledAmount and is imported by server, forecast and budget-template code.

scope.why: Only the six range computations, their comments, a test and a release note change.

maintainability.why: A future change to the range rule is one edit; a change to how missing or single amounts resolve would still touch several sites.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site still computes the range end itself; all use getRangedAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: Residual dispatch ternaries are pre-existing and left as they were, not reshaped copies.

one_place.where: getRangedAmount in shared/schedules.ts; used by getScheduledAmount, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, forecast normalizeSchedule and schedule-template createScheduleList.
